name: spotify-background
description: Spotify Background Controller for Spotify Connect playback without mouse, keyboard, or window focus changes.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex to play any song you want without interrupting what you're doing.
interface.longDescription: Spotify Background Controller is a personal Windows Spotify Connect controller with track search, explicit device selection, playback verification, PKCE authorization and encrypted token storage. Requires Spotify Premium and your own developer Client ID.
